recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a smiling man with a beard, bathed in warm, amber-toned lighting. A secondary, semi-transparent profile of a woman is layered into the dark shadows on the right side, creating a romantic, intimate atmosphere. The composition is tight, focusing on the eyes and smile, with a dark, vignetted background that allows gold-toned typography to pop in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary face dominates the left two-thirds of the frame
Secondary profile emerges from the shadows on the right
Warm skin tones contrast against deep black shadows
Gold typography sits in the negative space created by the shadow
coreInvariants: Soft-focus secondary figure in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject's face is scaled to fill the entire height of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and bright smile serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the primary subject's eyes, moves down to the smile, then shifts right to discover the hidden profile and finally the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the right side provide a functional area for the secondary figure and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep amber and copper skin tones provide the primary warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Rich black and dark brown shadows provide depth and contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold is used for the typography to suggest quality and warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the highlights of the face, low value in the surrounding shadows; saturation is concentrated in the warm orange-red spectrum.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a warm, monochromatic-adjacent palette

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Small caps for secondary text lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'R' and 'S' feature elongated, decorative swashes that curve into the composition

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the darkest area of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, swashed serif for the name paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif or small-cap serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classical serif feel with built-in swash options.
Provides the authoritative, cinematic serif look for the base skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up of a smiling man with a beard, lit with warm amber studio lights. In the dark shadows on the right, blend a soft, semi-transparent profile of a woman looking towards the man. The overall mood should be intimate and soulful with a dark vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name and album title in the lower right corner using a gold-toned serif font. Incorporate decorative swashes on the capital letters and ensure the text is left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly warm and amber?
Is the secondary profile visible but subtle?
Is the typography placed in the lower right negative space?
Does the cropping feel intimate and tight?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the amber color cast
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the two figures

postGenerationChecks: Check for skin texture realism in the extreme close-up
Ensure the gold text has enough contrast against the dark background
Verify the secondary profile does not distract from the main subject
Confirm the overall color palette remains warm and cohesive
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + warm amber lighting + secondary shadow profile + gold serif typography in lower right.
